newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai VAT rise will start from August 16.
newsitem.headline: Thai VAT rise will start from August 16.

text.p: Thailand will raise its value added tax (VAT) rate to 10 percent from seven percent effective August 16, the government spokesman said on Tuesday.

The VAT increase is a part of the government's compliance with International Monetary Fund (IMF) suggestions, Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said. He originally said the increase would be effective by fiscal 1997/98, which starts in October.
Government revenue is expected to rise by more than 70 billion baht ($2.26 billion) in the next fiscal year following the VAT increase.
